mprMaterialManager.t52: A preset is a set of material properties saved to a separate file in the user directory and available in any document. A preset changes the properties available for editing in the plugin window (except the material name and the appearance asset name), as well as the material parameters "Model", "Manufacturer", "URL" and "Cost". A preset is saved from one selected material and is applied to all selected materials at once
